lesson: Word List 8 — the last three words
cite: Wordly Wise 3000, Book 6, Word List 8, page 85
note: Page 85 of the Word List did not come with pages 83-84, so skirmish, supplement and territory were missing from ww6_l8.json and from all four of Lesson 8's apps. They are kept in a spec of their own rather than added to that one: the rehearsal next door is out of fifty points and the sentences set already asks for every word in it, so widening the list would break both. This is the catch-up section, and everything in it is from page 85 and nowhere else.

senses.head: skirmish
senses.sent: Apart from a few ____, both sides kept the cease-fire that had been agreed to.

senses.head: skirmish
senses.def: To take part in a minor fight or battle.
senses.sent: The two sides began to ____ before the major battle.

senses.head: supplement
senses.def: Something added to make up for something missing.
senses.sent: Those who eat a well-balanced diet probably do not need vitamin ____.

senses.head: supplement
senses.sent: I ____ my allowance with earnings from a paper route.

senses.head: territory
senses.def: A land area under the control of a particular group or government.
senses.sent: The island of Guam is a ____ of the United States.

rounds.name: The three that were left off
rounds.blurb: Six meanings over three words. Two of them do a noun's job and a verb's job, and the label on the word is the only thing that says which line it belongs on — territory is a noun twice, so either of its two words will do on either of its lines.
